SHA-256 ：EE064E3D82932CE7A3A16C6A7FA9764EAD5655B3F207C8C13CFE29A809A1BD74
This release introduces a new Onimusha: Way of the Sword theme, resolves stability issues related to multi-card configurations and recent NVIDIA drivers, and improves the underlying logic for both the Plug-in and Live Update features.
[Patch Notes]
• New: Added a theme based on Onimusha: Way of the Sword, available for supported ASUS graphics cards.
• Fixed: Resolved an issue where the Level Sense feature could cause GPU Tweak III to crash when switching between cards in a multi-card setup.
• Fixed: Addressed a bug that prevented GPU Tweak III from launching when NVIDIA GeForce Game Ready driver version 616.92 or later was installed.
• Updated: Expanded the scope of captured items for the Plug-in feature.
• Updated: Optimized the detection mechanism for the Live Update feature.

This update introduces an immediate shutdown threshold option to the Power Detector+ auto-shutdown feature and refines its settings UI for a better user experience. Additionally, it enhances overall software stability and resolves localization bugs affecting Korean text rendering and AMD graphics card metrics.
• New: Added a checkbox option to the Power Detector+ auto-shutdown feature to trigger an immediate shutdown when a specific threshold is reached.
• Update: Refined the UI layout in the Power Detector+ settings section.
• Improvement: Enhanced overall software stability.
• Fix: Resolved an issue where the "Don't remind me again" text in the Power Detector+ warning pop-up would display as garbled characters when the language was set to Korean.
• Fix: Resolved a localization bug where "GPU Clock" and "GPU Voltage" for AMD graphics cards were forced to display in English, regardless of the user's selected language setting.

Patch Notes:
This update enhances the Power Detector+ interface, giving users the flexibility to customize the 6-pin display to always show either the pin status or the current values. Additionally, it improves GPU Tweak III's startup speed and resolves a minor display issue regarding minimum pin values on certain platforms.
• Update: Redesigned the UI for the 6-pin display in Power Detector+. Users can now choose to persistently display either the 6-pin overall status or the real-time amperage.
• Improvement: Improved the startup speed of GPU Tweak III.
• Fix: Resolved an issue on certain platforms where the minimum (min) value for Power Detector+ pins would incorrectly display as “0” in the Monitor window.
